name: 1-Iodomorphine
summary: 1-Iodomorphine is a semi-synthetic narcotic analgesic formed by halogenation of the 1 position on the morphine carbon skeleton. Halogenated morphine derivatives were first synthesised in Germany, Austria/Austria-Hungary, the United Kingdom and the United States in the period 1890 to 1930. Use of this drug increased after 1945 for the below-mentioned research.

uses.text: It is a research chemical which is often prepared in the laboratory when it is needed.

summaryZh: 1-碘嗎啡（英語：1-iodomorphine）是由嗎啡碳骨架1位鹵化而成的半合成麻醉性鎮痛藥。1890年至1930年期間，德國、奧地利/奧匈帝國、英國和美國首先合成了鹵化嗎啡衍生物。1945年以後，這種藥物的使用有所增加，用於下述研究。它是一種研究性化學物質，通常在需要時在實驗室中製備。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing and kill. They also cause dependence, with a hard withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對1-碘嗎啡在人體的作用所知甚少。鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。這類藥物也會造成依賴，戒斷過程辛苦。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对1-碘吗啡在人体的作用所知甚少。鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。这类药物也会造成依赖，戒断过程辛苦。

fact.en: Like every morphine derivative, it traces back to morphine itself, which the German pharmacist Friedrich Sertürner isolated from opium in the early 1800s and named after Morpheus, the Greek god of dreams.
fact.zh: 和所有嗎啡衍生物一樣，它可以追溯到嗎啡本身。德國藥劑師Friedrich Sertürner在1800年代初從鴉片中分離出嗎啡，並以希臘夢神摩耳甫斯（Morpheus）命名。
fact.zhHans: 和所有吗啡衍生物一样，它可以追溯到吗啡本身。德国药剂师Friedrich Sertürner在1800年代初从鸦片中分离出吗啡，并以希腊梦神摩耳甫斯（Morpheus）命名。
